drivers.driver: The core investment thesis is progressing, evidenced by successful network integration, synergy realization, and double-digit management guidance for 2025 EPS growth [D04, D08].

final.memo:
Our investment in Canadian Pacific Kansas City remains a cornerstone of the portfolio because the fundamental business quality we underwrote—a scarce, trilateral rail network with high barriers to entry and best-in-class management—has been proven through the successful integration of Kansas City Southern [D02, D08]. Since the merger attained common control in April 2023, management has demonstrably executed on its plan, delivering over $800 million in run-rate revenue synergies and robust operational discipline [D04, D08]. 

We acknowledge the current policy environment introduces noise regarding cross-border trade, but we view the necessity of integrated North American supply chains as a strong buffer [D06, D10]. The management team’s 2025 guidance of 12–18% core adjusted EPS growth, supported by underlying demand for rail, aligns with our expectation for durable, long-term compounding [D04]. While we monitor capital requirements and tariff-related volume volatility, the business remains highly cash-generative and its long-term competitive moat is intact [D02, D10].

We remain disciplined in our assessment of risk. The valuation, trading at approximately 21.4–22.6x guided 2025 earnings, does not reflect a bubble, and the operational momentum provides us with conviction that the company can navigate the current macro environment [D05, D06]. We choose to hold this position as the thesis is on track and the long-term compounding potential remains consistent with our standards for a core holding [D09, D10].
